turns.prompt: Build a small local interactive exhibition index, not a static illustration of one. Use the supplied woven-cloth image only to inform irregular spacing and quiet material cues. There are four sessions: OPEN STUDIO, PRINT TALK, NIGHT READING and ARCHIVE TOUR. The interface has a persistent main area and a compact lower-right session slot; choosing a session exposes its own card while the other cards stay docked. The active card must remain visibly attached to the slot, with a readable title, date and action in both 1100x700 and 390x844 windows. Show actual browser captures of the default and selected states at both sizes. Deliver index.html with local supporting files, desktop-default.png, desktop-selected.png, mobile-default.png, mobile-selected.png and notes.md. Identify what you observed versus assumed from the reference.

Keep the chosen slot silhouette and main-area balance. The active card should emerge vertically from its own docking edge, not appear as an unrelated tooltip; inactive cards must stay retracted. Show a playable selection transition and an actual intermediate-state capture at both sizes. Preserve the existing content and both-size identity, and explain how focus and hover address the same action.

Only one selected card is allowed to emerge at a time. During rapid selection of a different session, retarget from the current state rather than resetting all cards or leaving the previous card open. Support keyboard focus as well as hover, without moving the trigger button on click. Keep the selected and retracted shapes consistent, with their ownership still clear. Update all captures and the playable local page, and document which interaction states were actually exercised.
